# JuaneloJGAC Tech — Full Details

> AI consulting agency helping startups and SMEs build smarter products, automations, and AI experiences. Practical AI solutions delivered with clarity, speed, and human-centered design.

## Company Overview

JuaneloJGAC Tech is an AI consulting and development agency that empowers startups and small-to-medium businesses (SMEs) with practical, intelligent AI solutions. Founded by Juan Almeida, we deliver projects with clarity, speed, and human-centered design.

We operate bilingually in English and Spanish, serving clients across the United States and Latin America. Our typical project delivery timeline is 4–12 weeks.

### Key Differentiators
- Fully bilingual services (English and Spanish)
- Specialized in startups and SMEs — not enterprise-only
- Practical, results-focused AI solutions — not theoretical
- Clean code approach with modern tech stacks
- Direct access to senior consultants
- US and Latin American market expertise

## Services

### 1. AI Automations Platform ($1,500–$5,000 USD)

Eliminate repetitive workflows with intelligent automation solutions that save time and reduce errors. Custom AI-powered automations designed for startups and SMEs.

**Use cases:**
- Automating customer support with AI chatbots
- Streamlining data entry and document processing
- Building intelligent workflow pipelines
- Integrating AI into existing business tools (CRM, ERP, etc.)
- Email and communication automation
- Inventory and order management automation

**Technologies:** OpenAI API, LangChain, custom LLM pipelines, Zapier/Make integrations, Python, Node.js

### 2. AI Marketing Studio ($1,500–$5,000 USD)

AI-driven content creation and marketing automation that resonates with your audience. Transform your marketing with intelligent content generation and campaign optimization.

**Use cases:**
- AI-powered content generation (blog posts, social media, ads)
- Marketing campaign optimization and A/B testing
- Customer segmentation and personalization
- SEO content strategy with AI assistance
- Social media management and scheduling
- Email marketing automation with AI personalization

**Technologies:** GPT-4, Claude, custom content pipelines, marketing automation platforms

### 3. AI-Powered Web Development ($1,500–$5,000 USD)

Fast, modern web platforms built with AI assistance. Custom e-commerce, dashboards, and web applications designed for growth and scalability.

**Use cases:**
- Custom e-commerce platforms with AI-powered recommendations
- Business dashboards and analytics platforms
- SaaS application development
- Landing pages and marketing websites
- Progressive web applications (PWAs)
- API development and third-party integrations

**Technologies:** React, Next.js, Astro, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, PostgreSQL, AI-assisted development

### 4. AI Consultancy & Digital Transformation ($1,500–$5,000 USD)

Strategic AI consulting to transform your business processes. Expert guidance on AI implementation, automation strategy, and digital transformation roadmaps.

**Use cases:**
- AI readiness assessments
- Digital transformation strategy and roadmaps
- AI tool selection and vendor evaluation
- Process automation audits
- AI implementation planning and oversight
- Team training on AI tools and workflows

**Deliverables:** Strategy documents, implementation roadmaps, ROI projections, vendor recommendations, training materials

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What AI consulting services do you offer for startups?
We offer four core services: AI Automations (workflow automation), AI Marketing Studio (content and campaign automation), AI-Powered Web Development (modern web platforms), and AI Consultancy & Digital Transformation (strategic guidance). All services are priced between $1,500–$5,000 USD and tailored for startups and SMEs.

### How much do AI automation solutions cost?
Our AI automation solutions range from $1,500 to $5,000 USD depending on complexity. This includes custom AI-powered workflow automations, chatbot development, document processing, and integration with existing business tools.

### Do you serve clients in Latin America?
Yes. We are fully bilingual (English and Spanish) and serve clients across the United States and Latin America. We have offices in Milton, Florida (US) and Quito, Ecuador.

### What does your AI web development process look like?
We follow an agile approach: discovery call, requirements gathering, design and architecture, iterative development with AI assistance, testing, and deployment. Most projects are delivered within 4–12 weeks. We use modern technologies like React, Astro, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

### Can you help my small business with AI integration?
Absolutely. We specialize in helping small and medium businesses adopt AI practically. Whether you need to automate repetitive tasks, improve your marketing with AI, build a modern web platform, or develop an AI strategy, we can help. Our services start at $1,500 USD.

### What makes JuaneloJGAC Tech different from other AI agencies?
We focus exclusively on startups and SMEs, not large enterprises. We are fully bilingual (English/Spanish), deliver in 4–12 weeks, and take a practical approach to AI — focusing on real business results rather than theoretical possibilities. You work directly with senior consultants, not junior staff.

### How do I get started?
Book a free consultation at https://calendly.com/juanelojga/one-on-one-meeting or email us at juan.almeida@juanelojgac-tech.com. You can also chat with our AI consultant on our website at https://juanelojgac-tech.com.
